Graduate Programs
Welcome! We are excited to share the graduate program opportunities that our department
offers. MSU is among the top 3 percent of colleges and universities in the nation
for research expenditures, and has Carnegie classification for very high research
activity.
Degrees Offered
We offer the following graduate degrees and certificates:
Computer Science Ph.D.
Computer Science M.S.
Cybersecurity M.S.
Data Science M.S. (administered by the Department of Mathematical Sciences)
Artificial Intelligence Certificate
After learning more by following one of the links above, please consider submitting
an Application for Graduate Admissions!
Important Dates
For Fall admission:
January 15 – Priority application deadline for Ph.D. students.
March 15 – Application deadline.
For Spring admission:
September 1 – Application deadline.
Research Opportunities
See our department's research webpage to learn about our research focus areas, research facilities, faculty research interests,
and new developments.
Funding Opportunities
Incoming Ph.D. students are typically funded with teaching assistantships for their
first year. During that period, they connect with faculty and typically receive research
assistantships for the remainder of their graduate studies. Other opportunities include
the College of Engineering's Benjamin Fellowship for first year Ph.D. students and the Graduate School's funding and fellowship opportunities.
Incoming M.S. students are welcome to apply to be a teaching assistant after they
are offered admission. However, because the application process is competitive, an
M.S. student needs to be prepared to self-fund their studies.
Life in Bozeman
Known for its high quality of life and regularly featured on national "Best Places"
lists, Bozeman combines a vibrant downtown, walkable and bikeable neighborhoods, and
easy access to nearby mountains and rivers. Learn more.
